notes.title: 🩸 Major Update
notes.notes:
⚙️ Optimization
The project has become significantly lighter on system load.
Lighting, shadow calculations, draw distance, texture streaming, and other systems have been reworked.
Performance has increased by 1.5–2× compared to the previous version.
[hr][/hr]📖 Tutorial
A short comic has been added during the loading screen.
It helps new players get into the core of the game more smoothly.
[hr][/hr]📊 Progress
The HUD now shows:

Number of totems collected,

Number of deaths,

Completion timer.

For speedrunners:
Start and finish points are now fixed — the same for everyone.
You can now compare results fairly.
[hr][/hr]⚽ New Quest
The Mystery of the Ball.
It helps pass the time while waiting —
but those who go all the way may unlock something unexpected.
Though it might raise even more questions.
[hr][/hr]🌀 New Area
Take part in a hunt, touched by an eastern breeze.
[hr][/hr]🛠 Minor Improvements
Catapult mechanics improved,

Highlighting added to interactive elements,

Visual cues and hints slightly clarified.

notes.title: Update 11/01/2025. Smooth start.
